# SpatiotemporalComplexityIndex

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-07-30

## Definition
A metric (CST) that quantifies the joint spatial and temporal complexity of neural computations under interconnect and topology constraints. Enables in-network or near-network approximation of CST to reduce full-data backhaul costs while preserving stability across different topologies.
